scope: exploratory full 384-question DEV scoring after complete formal and independent no-GT acceptance
inputs: exact 384-question accepted E1 DEV panel; reference answer values only after all gates
primary_reporting: per-task PixelPrune official and independent mean plus dynamic selected-token K distribution, 128 questions per task
comparisons: paired per-question score differences versus accepted E1 P3-D1, E4 K256 DS-on and E4 K1024 DS-on; task-specific and exploratory
answer_access: DEV question IDs only; do not decode CONFIRM or FINAL answer values
required_before_predictions_or_labels: complete 384-question formal no-GT acceptance and actual supervisor exit
independent complete-record review and actual supervisor exit
independent scoring-source and synthetic-counterexample prelaunch review
limitations: Scoring plan follows earlier exploratory DEV results and is not a prospectively preregistered confirmatory hypothesis
no multiplicity correction; no claim of statistical equivalence from a crossing-zero interval
dynamic token K changes both compute and accuracy; K256 and K1024 are not equal-compute controls
instrumented generation gives no latency or cost result
AI2D uses the same deterministic local score convention as the existing E1 analysis
